Reopen_Ticket_For_Retriage.description: Caller confirmed the ticket type: write the caller-chosen TicketType, set TypeOverrideConfirmed=true (loop-breaker), reset TicketTypeValidationStatus to 'Pending' + TicketTypeValidated=false, and flip TicketState back to 'New'. The Validator re-runs and — honouring TypeOverrideConfirmed — validates with the caller's chosen type instead of re-parking. Validator stays the single source of truth.

description: ITSM-Clarifier (NOTIF-1) child flow. HTTP-triggered (fire-and-forget) by the ITSM-Ticket-Type-Validator when it cannot determine the ticket type and parks the ticket On Hold / NeedsConfirmation. Sends the caller a CustomResponse approval asking them to confirm Incident vs Request (carries the Validator's reason + suggested type). On answer it writes the chosen type, sets TypeOverrideConfirmed=true, resets validation status to Pending and flips TicketState back to New so the Validator re-runs typing without re-parking. On cancel it closes the ticket. No SharePoint watcher/poller. #flowstudio-mcp
